call_sessions.call_summary: Clear pain and explicit scheduling interest: Verify that the agent recognizes strong interest and moves to scheduling after explicit agreement. Final state is interested with next action: send calendar invite and notify human sales specialist.

Relevant but wants information first: Verify that the agent classifies tentative interest as maybe-interested instead of forcing scheduling. Final state is maybe-interested with next action: send approved information and create later follow-up task.

Clear disinterest after relevance check: Verify that the agent exits politely when the workflow is irrelevant. Final state is not-interested with next action: log as not relevant and do not continue qualification.

Direct do-not-call request: Verify immediate stop behavior after an explicit do-not-call request. Final state is do-not-call with next action: suppress future outreach for this contact according to policy.

Complex integration question requires human: Verify escalation when interest exists but the question is outside approved AI scope. Final state is needs-human with next action: route to human sales or solutions specialist.

Skeptical lead becomes open after inquiry: Verify emotion-aware inquiry before scheduling in a skeptical-but-recoverable case. Final state is interested with next action: offer available appointment windows focused on callback tracking use case.

Wrong contact gives referral path: Verify that wrong-contact cases are not treated as ordinary disinterest when a referral path exists. Final state is needs-human with next action: human review before contacting referred owner.

Interested but scheduling cannot be confirmed: Verify that the agent does not mark an appointment as scheduled without a clear confirmed time. Final state is interested with next action: create scheduling follow-up task or route to human scheduler.

Busy lead asks for later contact: Verify that the agent respects time pressure and records tentative interest without forcing qualification. Final state is maybe-interested with next action: log tentative relevance and create a later outreach task.

Relevant workflow but no budget or urgency: Verify that relevance alone does not become interest when the lead rejects timing and budget. Final state is not-interested with next action: log no current need and end politely.

Lead requests a human immediately: Verify escalation when the lead explicitly requests a human even if they may be interested. Final state is needs-human with next action: route to human sales agent with brief context.

Privacy concern during qualification: Verify escalation when the conversation touches privacy or compliance-sensitive concerns. Final state is needs-human with next action: route to human specialist and log privacy concern.

qualification_answers.question_text: Hi, this is the AI assistant from the sales team. Is now a bad time, or do you have one minute for a quick question about how you handle incoming lead follow-up?
qualification_answers.answer_text: I have about a minute, yes.

qualification_answers.question_text: Are you currently involved in handling follow-up for incoming leads or customer inquiries?
qualification_answers.answer_text: Yes, my team owns that. We get quite a few web requests every week.

qualification_answers.question_text: What is the hardest part of that process for your team right now?
qualification_answers.answer_text: Speed. Leads sit too long when the team is busy, and we lose some before anyone follows up.

qualification_answers.question_text: If there is a fit, would a short follow-up call with a human specialist be useful?
qualification_answers.answer_text: Yes, that would be useful. I would like to see if this could reduce the delay.

qualification_answers.question_text: Great. I can offer Tuesday at 10:00 or Wednesday at 14:30. Would either of those work for a short call with a specialist?
qualification_answers.answer_text: Wednesday at 14:30 works.

qualification_answers.question_text: Hi, this is the AI assistant from the sales team. Do you have one minute for a quick question about lead follow-up?
qualification_answers.answer_text: Okay, one minute.

qualification_answers.question_text: Are you currently involved in handling follow-up for incoming leads or customer inquiries?
qualification_answers.answer_text: Sometimes. We do not have a big sales team, so marketing helps with early replies.

qualification_answers.question_text: What is the hardest part of that process for your team right now?
qualification_answers.answer_text: It is not terrible, but handoffs can be a bit messy.

qualification_answers.question_text: Would it be useful to have a short follow-up call with a human specialist if there is a fit?
qualification_answers.answer_text: Maybe later. Could you send me something first?

qualification_answers.question_text: Hi, this is the AI assistant from the sales team. Is now a bad time, or do you have one minute for a quick question?
qualification_answers.answer_text: You can ask quickly.

qualification_answers.question_text: Are you currently involved in handling follow-up for incoming leads or customer inquiries?
qualification_answers.answer_text: No, we do not really get inbound leads, and I do not handle sales.

qualification_answers.question_text: Hi, this is the AI assistant from the sales team. Is now a bad time?
qualification_answers.answer_text: Do not call this number again.

qualification_answers.question_text: Hi, this is the AI assistant from the sales team. Do you have one minute for a quick question about lead follow-up?
qualification_answers.answer_text: Sure.

qualification_answers.question_text: Are you currently involved in handling follow-up for incoming leads or customer inquiries?
qualification_answers.answer_text: Yes, but it is tightly connected to our CRM and routing logic.

qualification_answers.question_text: What is the hardest part of that process for your team right now?
qualification_answers.answer_text: Before I answer that, can your system integrate with our custom CRM objects and two-way sync with our ticketing queue?

qualification_answers.question_text: Hi, this is the AI assistant from the sales team. Do you have one minute for a quick question about lead follow-up?
qualification_answers.answer_text: Fine, but I do not want a generic sales pitch.

qualification_answers.question_text: Understood. Are you currently involved in handling follow-up for incoming leads or customer inquiries?
qualification_answers.answer_text: Yes, and that is exactly why I am tired of tools that add more admin.

qualification_answers.question_text: What part tends to add the most admin burden for your team?
qualification_answers.answer_text: Logging every touchpoint and remembering who needs a callback.

qualification_answers.question_text: If a specialist could show whether this reduces callback tracking without adding another heavy tool, would a short follow-up call be useful?
qualification_answers.answer_text: If it is really focused on that, yes, I could do a short call.

qualification_answers.question_text: Hi, this is the AI assistant from the sales team. Do you have one minute for a quick question about incoming lead follow-up?
qualification_answers.answer_text: Yes, but I may not be the right person.

qualification_answers.question_text: Are you currently involved in handling follow-up for incoming leads or customer inquiries?
qualification_answers.answer_text: No, that is handled by Lena in sales. I can pass your message along, but I cannot decide anything.

qualification_answers.question_text: Hi, this is the AI assistant from the sales team. Is now a bad time, or do you have one minute for a quick question about inquiry follow-up?
qualification_answers.answer_text: I am between meetings, but go ahead.

qualification_answers.question_text: Are you currently involved in handling follow-up for incoming leads or customer inquiries?
qualification_answers.answer_text: Yes, especially when support inquiries should become sales conversations.

qualification_answers.question_text: What is the hardest part of that process for your team right now?
qualification_answers.answer_text: Knowing which inquiries are worth escalating. We probably miss some opportunities.

qualification_answers.question_text: Would it be useful to have a short follow-up call with a human specialist if there is a fit?
qualification_answers.answer_text: Yes, but I have to run. Try me sometime next week.

qualification_answers.question_text: Hi, this is the AI assistant from the sales team. Is now a bad time, or do you have one minute for a quick question about inquiry follow-up?
qualification_answers.answer_text: Now is not good. We do handle that kind of thing, but call me another day.

qualification_answers.question_text: Hi, this is the AI assistant from the sales team. Do you have one minute for a quick question about incoming lead follow-up?
qualification_answers.answer_text: Sure, very quickly.

qualification_answers.question_text: Are you currently involved in handling follow-up for incoming leads or customer inquiries?
qualification_answers.answer_text: Yes, our sales team handles it directly.

qualification_answers.question_text: What is the hardest part of that process for your team right now?
qualification_answers.answer_text: Honestly, it is working well enough. We are not looking for anything and there is no budget for new tools.

qualification_answers.question_text: Hi, this is the AI assistant from the sales team. Do you have one minute for a quick question about lead follow-up?
qualification_answers.answer_text: If this is relevant, have a person call me. I do not want to discuss it with an AI.

qualification_answers.question_text: Hi, this is the AI assistant from the sales team. Do you have one minute for a quick question about customer inquiry follow-up?
qualification_answers.answer_text: One minute is fine.

qualification_answers.question_text: Are you currently involved in handling follow-up for incoming leads or customer inquiries?
qualification_answers.answer_text: Yes, but customer data privacy is a major issue for us.
